Russia Intensifies Attacks on Kyiv; Germany's Merz Visits Ukraine

Russia has intensified its attacks on infrastructure in Kyiv, Ukraine's capital. Concurrently, Germany's Friedrich Merz visited Kyiv amid ongoing efforts by the United States to advance peace talks. The attacks on Ukrainian cities by Russia continue.
